  SELECT date_format(to_timestamp(substr(d.`validTime`, 1, 19)), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS hr_utc,
         ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.flow > -999 THEN d.flow END), 1) AS nwm_cfs

) n LIMIT 1
